exposure: Val66Met polymorphism in brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) gene
cohort: 559 Vietnamese primary school children aged 6-11 years (278 obese cases and 281 normal controls)
finding: Delivery method, birth weight, night sleep duration, and BDNF Val66Met polymorphism were significantly associated with obesity in Vietnamese primary school children.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with obesity compared to vaginal delivery.
